name: @aliran/i18n
description: Aliran viewer i18n — zero-dependency translation runtime, React hook and locale catalogs shared by the mobile/TV and desktop apps
comment: Ships TypeScript source with NO build step — both viewer apps consume it directly (Metro reads it through client/metro.config.js watchFolders, esbuild bundles TS+JSON natively for the desktop renderer), the same arrangement as sdk/react-native. Operator surfaces (panel/ broadcaster/ reseller/ library/) stay English and must NOT depend on this package.
